links.comparator_used: Baseline single-threshold model alerting (Stage 1 model without tiered risk stratification)
links.outcome: Positive predictive value for in-hospital mortality alerts, with NPV in low-risk patients
links.effect: PPV rose from baseline 9.8-18.8% to 32.5-40.5% across sites; NPV stayed over 98% for low-risk individuals
links.quote: In Stage 2, AI-TEW implements a tiered risk stratification strategy by optimizing decision thresholds to prioritize high-risk patients, thereby increasing PPV from baseline levels of 9.8-18.8% to 32.5-40.5% across sites, while maintaining a high negative predictive value (NPV) of over 98% for low-risk individuals.

links.comparator_used: Stage 1 model alerts without LLM knowledge-based filtering
links.outcome: PPV in external validation after LLM filtering of SHAP-derived risk factors
links.effect: 11.53% increase in PPV in external validation (p = 0.0092 for MedGemma)
links.quote: Integrating explainable AI with clinical reasoning enhances contextual understanding and reduces spurious alerts, leading to an 11.53% increase in PPV in external validation (p = 0.0092 for MedGemma).
